meta.name: security-monitor
meta.description: Real-time security monitoring for Clawdbot. Detects intrusions, unusual API calls, credential usage patterns, and alerts on breaches.

copy.tagline: 实时监控安全威胁，发现入侵和异常行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要实时监控系统安全并快速响应威胁。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor security threats in real time, detect intrusions and anomalies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need real-time security monitoring and quick threat response.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会持续监控 Clawdbot 的安全状况，检测入侵、异常 API 调用、凭据使用模式等，并在发现安全事件时发出警报。
howto.when: 当用户启动监控脚本（如 node skills/security-monitor/scripts/monitor.cjs --interval 60）或设置为守护进程模式时触发。

say.text: 开始实时安全监控，每60秒检查一次。
say.note: 启动监控，默认检查所有威胁类型。

say.text: 监控凭据泄露和端口扫描。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude continuously monitors Clawdbot's security, detecting intrusions, unusual API calls, credential usage patterns, and alerts on breaches.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user starts the monitoring script (e.g., node skills/security-monitor/scripts/monitor.cjs --interval 60) or runs it in daemon mode.

say_en.text: Start real-time security monitoring every 60 seconds.
Monitor for credential leaks and port scanning.
